export PATH=/ccc/scratch/cont002/cerfacs/drozdalu/software/julia-1.13.0/bin:$PATH
export JULIA_DEPOT_PATH=/ccc/scratch/cont002/cerfacs/drozdalu/.julia
mpirun -np 4 --map-by ppr:2:node julia -e '
using MPI, CUDA
import JACC
MPI.Init()
comm = MPI.COMM_WORLD
rank = MPI.Comm_rank(comm)
nranks = MPI.Comm_size(comm)
local_rank = parse(Int, get(ENV, "OMPI_COMM_WORLD_LOCAL_RANK", "0"))
ndev = length(CUDA.devices())
local_dev = ndev == 1 ? 0 : (local_rank % ndev)
CUDA.device!(local_dev)

function make_rank_array(r::Int)
    a = JACC.zeros(Float32, 4)
    val = Float32(r + 1)
    JACC.parallel_for(4, (i, x) -> x[i] = val, a)
    return a
end
a = make_rank_array(rank)

path = "jacc_array_direct"
result = zeros(Float32, 4)
try
    result_dev = similar(a)
    MPI.Allreduce!(a, result_dev, MPI.SUM, comm)
    result = Array(result_dev)
catch e
    global path = "host_array_fallback"
    result_host = zeros(Float32, 4)
    MPI.Allreduce!(Array(a), result_host, MPI.SUM, comm)
    global result = result_host
end

expected = Float32(sum(1:nranks))
ok = all(result .== expected)
if rank == 0
    println("local_dev=", local_dev, " path=", path, " nranks=", nranks, " allreduce_correct=", ok)
    println(ok ? "PASS: multi_node_dual_gpu" : "FAIL: multi_node_dual_gpu")
end
'
